$comment: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for every /go/[slug] redirect. The build (prebuild -> scripts/generate-redirects.mjs) reads this and writes public/_redirects, so each /go/<slug> 302s to its destination at the Cloudflare edge. NEVER put raw merchant URLs in posts, products.ts, deals.ts, or promos.ts — always reference /go/<slug> and add the destination here. For Amazon, the destination is the product page + your single tag appended: https://www.amazon.com/dp/{ASIN}?tag={YOUR_TAG}. The tag below is the LIVE Amazon Associates tag sleekdrops-22. The example ASINs below are still placeholders — replace each with the real product ASIN.
